name: code-collaborator
description: Real-time collaborative code editor: Yjs CRDT sync over WebSockets, live cursors, rooms that survive restarts, and a pluggable code runner.
author: Neelmayank Rawat <rawatneelmayank1@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
